title: The Vault's Stone
journal: The second seal-stone lies in the lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin, which is under water. The dead walk the vaults and a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be searching there. I'm to go down and take it. I can fight through, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin. (marker: Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin)
Read the Tablet of the Kings beside the stone. (marker: Tablet of the Kings)

plan.going: I am hunting the three seal-stones for the Toh-Reel-Ka; this one is in Gemin's drowned lowest hall
plan.next: go down through the vaults to the lowest hall and take the stone; read the tablet beside it
plan.ways: fight the Unbound, the dead and the wraith; slip past them (Sneak); turn the dead and the wraith (Restoration); I must swim the last hall, or carry waterbreathing

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice. I am collecting three Seal-Stones of the Kings, which all go into the gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth, leading to the Eye at the Root. I already have the first stone. The Unbound are also searching and the Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is a rival.
Go down into the flooded Vaults of Gemin, take the second seal-stone from the lowest hall, and read the Tablet of the Kings beside it.
Fight through the dead and Unbound, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration. I also have paralysis poison x3 to help against the wraith.
I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees and drain them, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound. The Tablet may tell me more; I can ask people.

title: The Vault's Stone
journal: I took the second seal-stone from the drowned hall of Gemin. The tablet beside it says that the Eye, lifted, parts every tree from every other, and used where it sits, it strengthens them. I already carry the thief's stone from Blackrose. One is left, in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and it is still marked.

answers: I took the second seal-stone from Gemin. The tablet says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other, and if used where it sits, strengthens them. I hold two stones; one remains in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl.
Go to Vorannuhl (boat near Noota Nara) for the third stone, then take all three to the Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.
I can fight or sneak through Vorannuhl; the tablet suggests a choice later between lifting the Eye or using it in place.
I still do not understand why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound. I can ask people and read further.
